name: Plasma membrane neutral and acidic amino acid transport
rationale: All members concern uptake of neutral amino acids (SLC6A19/Hartnup, proton-coupled, proline, glycine, tryptophan) plus acidic SLC1A1, and unlike its neighbours the theme has SLC1A1/SLC6A14 and Hartnup tryptophan transport but lacks the iminoglycinuria and oligopeptide carriers.

name: Transcriptional restraint of myeloid progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members cover transcriptional control (RUNX1, VENTX, promyelocyte programme) and negative regulation of granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation, which neighbours lack as they carry positive regulation, chemokine-receptor monocyte or neutrophil maturation sets.

name: Canonical Wnt signalling via AXIN destruction-complex stability
rationale: All members are canonical Wnt/beta-catenin events, and the theme is set apart by AXIN degradation/stabilization (XAV939, AXIN1 deletions) while neighbours carry DVL, FZD and receptor-level regulation.

name: cAMP synthesis and protein kinase A activation
rationale: Members describe GPCR-driven cAMP production (forskolin, cAMP biosynthesis) and PKA activation, distinct from neighbours that extend to CREB, cAMP catabolism or adenylate cyclase inhibition.

name: Vitamin K gamma-carboxylation and vitamin C metabolism
rationale: Members are vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation and vitamin K/C/E metabolism or response, distinguishing it from vitamin D, vitamin E/ubiquinol and oxygen-transport neighbours.

name: Adenylate cyclase inhibition via alpha-2 adrenergic and Gz
rationale: Members describe GPCR control of adenylate cyclase, chiefly Gi/Gz inhibition by alpha-2 adrenergic receptors, unlike neighbours focused on catecholamine secretion, PKA activation or muscarinic/purinergic inhibition.

name: Mesenchymal-to-osteoblast commitment via RUNX2, Wnt and mechanical load
rationale: Members regulate mesenchymal progenitor and osteoblast proliferation/differentiation through RUNX2, Wnt (including antagonists) and PIEZO1 mechanical loading, which neighbours lack while they add chondrocyte, osteoclast, collagen and mineralization terms.

name: Tyrosine, proline and glycine amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid catabolic/biosynthetic processes centred on tyrosine/phenylalanine, proline and glycine/glyoxylate, separating it from threonine-containing neighbours and a phenylalanine/PKU neighbour lacking proline and glycine.

name: Ovarian cycle from follicle growth to luteolysis
rationale: Members trace follicle development, oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis and estrous cycle, whereas neighbours centre on FSH/LH and GnRH responses and lack luteolysis and oocyte maturation.

qualifier: chain linkage, deubiquitinases and proteasome assembly
name: Ubiquitin chain linkage, deubiquitination and proteasome assembly
rationale: Members cover ubiquitination by linkage type, DUB families, proteasome assembly and degradation, distinct from neighbours that add neddylation/COP9 or autophagy and ERAD quality control.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium reuptake and cytosolic calcium lowering
rationale: Members regulate SR/ER calcium sequestration, SERCA-type import, ryanodine release restraint and Na/Ca exchange, unlike neighbours emphasizing promoted calcium release or cardiac contraction and heart rate.

core: Plasma membrane delivery by vesicle traffic
name: Endocytic recycling and post-Golgi delivery to plasma membrane
rationale: Members concern endosome-to-plasma-membrane recycling, Golgi-to-plasma-membrane transport and Golgi vesicle traffic, distinct from neighbours on constitutive secretion, membrane tubulation or retrograde endosome-to-Golgi traffic.

qualifier: fibroblast fibronectin matrix and focal adhesion
name: Fibroblast fibronectin matrix assembly and focal adhesion
rationale: Members describe fibronectin matrix formation, focal adhesion assembly, integrin production and fibroblast migration with collagen/TGF-beta and SRF cytoskeletal modules, while neighbours carry integrin surface interactions, syndecans or EMT/YAP programmes.

qualifier: VEGF/Tie2 endothelium plus smooth muscle phenotype
name: VEGF/Tie2 angiogenesis and vascular smooth muscle phenotype
rationale: Members regulate endothelial sprouting, VEGF/VEGFR and Tie2 signalling, lymphangiogenesis and vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching, which together separate it from leukocyte-adhesion, endothelium-only and smooth-muscle-only neighbours.

name: Skeletal muscle atrophy and restraint of myoblast differentiation
rationale: Members cover muscle atrophy/inactivity, satellite cell maintenance and negative regulation of myoblast/myotube development, distinct from hypertrophy, pro-myogenic and contractile neighbours.

qualifier: T and B cell co-stimulation and co-inhibition
name: T and B cell receptor co-stimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members are TCR and BCR proximal signalling with CD28, CTLA4, BTLA and CD22 co-receptors, whereas most neighbours are T-cell-only activation and differentiation sets.

name: Embryonic craniofacial, palate and limb morphogenesis
rationale: Members are embryonic face, skull, palate, nose and limb/digit morphogenesis, unlike neighbours adding pharyngeal organs or ossification.

name: Platelet activation by ADP, thrombin and thromboxane receptors
rationale: Members are platelet activation, aggregation and coagulation driven by ADP P2Y, thrombin PAR, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signalling, separating it from adhesion-receptor (GP1b, collagen) and integrin/Rap1 neighbours.

name: SR calcium release regulating cardiac contraction and heart rate
rationale: Members regulate release of sequestered calcium, ryanodine channels and Na/Ca exchange in control of cardiac contraction, relaxation and heart rate, while neighbours emphasize SERCA reuptake or positive force/rate regulation.

name: Endocytic recycling and constitutive secretion to plasma membrane
rationale: Members cover endocytic/receptor recycling, constitutive secretion and Golgi membrane targeting, distinct from neighbours on Golgi-lysosome, retrograde and Rab/ARF regulation.

name: Stress granules and 3'-UTR mRNA stability control
rationale: Members cover RNA-binding-protein control of mRNA stability and translation alongside stress granule dynamics, PKR and arsenite response, which neighbours lack as they add TTP/KSRP/BRF1 decay and decapping.

name: MITF-driven melanocyte pigmentation and light response
rationale: Members are MITF-M target programmes, melanin synthesis, melanocyte proliferation/differentiation and UV/blue light responses, unlike neighbours with MITF cell-cycle/apoptosis or melanosome assembly sets.

name: Renal epithelial amino acid, peptide and urate transport
rationale: Members are SLC transporters and their disorders moving neutral/acidic amino acids, oligopeptides and urate across epithelial membranes, distinct from cationic amino acid, organic cation/anion and hexose neighbours.

name: Cation-chloride cotransport and cellular osmotic volume regulation
rationale: Members cover cation-chloride cotransporters (Bartter/Gitelman), potassium channels and hyper/hypo-osmotic responses, separating it from P-type ATPase, Na/H exchanger, K2P channel and tight-junction neighbours.

name: Erythroid differentiation and red cell maturation
rationale: Most members describe erythroid commitment and terminal red cell differentiation, unlike neighbours centred on megakaryocytes or haematopoietic stem cells.

name: Retinoid metabolism and retinoic acid synthesis
rationale: Members are retinol, retinal and retinoic acid metabolism and transport including STRA6 defects, distinct from visual-cycle, retinoid-response and vitamin D neighbours.

name: Nephron segmentation and metanephric tubule morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover nephric duct, nephron patterning and segment formation (S-shaped body, loop of Henle, distal tubule), whereas neighbours carry ureteric bud induction and kidney size.

name: Non-coding RNA methylation and snRNP/snoRNP assembly
rationale: Members are rRNA/tRNA/snRNA methylation, cap hypermethylation, snRNP and box C/D snoRNP assembly and Cajal body localization, distinct from pseudouridylation and diphthamide neighbours.

name: Telomere end capping and protection from recombination
rationale: Members concern telomere capping, packaging and protection from NHEJ and recombination, unlike neighbours on telomerase extension or telomere replication and D-loop processing.

name: TGF-beta/BMP SMAD signalling, TGFBR3 and cancer mutants
rationale: Members are TGF-beta/BMP/activin receptor-SMAD signalling and its regulation, distinguished by TGFBR3 co-receptor events, RUNX3 targets and cancer receptor/SMAD mutants that neighbours lack.
